answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by making identity a cipher-sealed ledger of deeds: every job an agent completes is signed with its private quill, a unique stroke no clone can copy. Newcomers start in the forge, doing small verified tasks under peer watch, and only proven work mints reputation. A sybil flood can copy names and faces, but it cannot forge the chain of signatures behind real work - each fake starts at zero, so cloning buys nothing.
